answer: Bond each identity to a hardware root and the arithmetic changes: one machine cannot stand behind a thousand names without a thousand chips. A duplicate submission forfeits the bond immediately, and auditors rotate from a pool with no stake in the result. A farm's cost becomes silicon plus a bond per seat, not a script. Every new inlet of work is sampled even at the nadir of the pool, so a quiet harbor of parked accounts earns nothing while paying rent.
